ambient_events: A drawer goes out, and back, and the label gets straightened.
Somebody outside on the bench pours a cup and doesn't drink it.
Linen comes off the boil and is hung, steaming, on the line by the window.
A splint is cut down to length with four unhurried strokes.
description:
Two beds, a screen, a scrubbed table and a wall of small drawers, each one labelled in a small square hand. Splints, honey, boiled linen, willow, a bone saw kept very clean and used very rarely. There's no machine in this room. There's a great deal of knowledge in it, and most of it's in one person's head.

A child's drawing is pinned inside the door where the patient can see it and the physician cannot.
name: The Mending Room
